name: 提问台
description: 让 agent 在会话中间向你提问：结构化选项、可选自定义回答，答完自动继续。

views.title: 提问台
views.description: agent 问过你什么、你回答了什么

tools.name: ask_user
tools.label: 向你提问
tools.description: Ask the user structured questions and wait for the answers. Use it when a decision, preference, or missing detail blocks progress: unclear requirements, a risky irreversible step, or several reasonable options. Prefer asking over guessing. Keep it to the questions you actually need, 1-4 is usually enough.

question.description: The question itself, one sentence, concrete.

header.description: Very short label shown above the question (2-6 chars), e.g. 数据库 / 部署方式.

multiSelect.description: Allow selecting several options at once.

options.description: 2-8 concrete choices. The user can always type a custom answer instead.

settings.label: 等待回答的最长时间（秒）
settings.description: 超时按「未回答」继续；0 表示一直等，直到你作答或取消。

settings.label: 在提问台保留记录
settings.description: 关闭后只影响历史列表，提问本身照常工作。
